spans.s: उपेप्सा, f. desire to obtain.
उपेप्सा उपेप्सा. See under उपाप्.

उपे 1. उपे (उप-इ), cl. 2. P. उपैति, -तुम्,
to go near, approach (as a friend or enemy); come
near to, arrive at, reach; to go to (a master), become
a pupil; to undergo, perform, undertake, devote one's
self to; to pass into any state, to fall into (misfortune
&c.), incur, be present at; to obtain; to fall to one's
share; to befal; to regard as, admit, acknowledge.

उपे 2. उपे (उप-आ-इ), cl. 2. P. उपैति, -तुम्,
to come near to, go to, approach, visit; to have
sexual intercourse with; to undergo, incur, fall into
(misfortune &c.).

उपेत, अस्, आ, अम्, come near, approached, arrived
at, come near to, present, existent; accompanied by,
[]
endowed with, possessed of, having, possessing; sur-
rounded, invested; fallen into.
उपेति, इस्, f., Ved. approach, arrival.
उपेत्य, ind. having approached, having gone near.

उपेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gone to or approached,
to be effected by any means; assailable; to be sought,
to be had recourse to.

उपेयिवस्, आन्, युषी, अत्, accompanied or followed
by, associated with, united; obtained, got.

उपेक्ष् उपेक्ष् (उप-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. उपेक्षते,
षितुम्, to look at, regard; to perceive; to notice,
have regard to; to consider, expect; to overlook,
disregard; to neglect, to quit, abandon; to despise.
उपेक्ष, अस्, m., N. of a son of Śvaphalka.

उपेक्षा, f. overlooking, negligence, neglect; in-
diference, contempt, disdain; abandoning, leaving;
endurance, patience; dissent; trick, deceit (as one of
the minor expedients in war); regard.

उपेक्षक, अस्, आ, अम्, disregarding, neglecting,
looking at inattentively, disdaining; patient, enduring.

उपेक्षण, अम्, n. overlooking, looking at without
interest or attention, disregarding, neglecting, disdain-
ing; leaving, abandoning.

उपेक्षणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be neglected or dis-
regarded.

उपेक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, disregarded, disesteemed,
neglected, disdained.

उपेक्षितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be looked at, to be
regarded, to be examined; to be disregarded.

उपेक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be regarded or examined;
to be disregarded or neglected.

उपेन् उपेन् (उप-इन्), cl. 8. P. उपेनोति (cl. 6.
P. fr. इन्व्, उपेन्वति), to press in, force in.
उपेनित, अस्, आ, अम्, driven or pressed in, turned in.

उपेन्द्र उपेन्द्र, अस्, m. (fr. उप-इन्˚), N. of
Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa as the younger brother of Indra,
(born subsequently to Indra, especially as son of
Aditi, either as an Āditya or in the Vāmana Avatār);
N. of a king of the Nāgas; (आ), f., N. of a river.
—उपेन्द्र-दत्त, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—उपेन्द्र-
बल, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—उपेन्द्र-वज्रा, f. a
metre of four lines of eleven syllables each.

उपेष् 1. उपेष् (उप-ईष्), cl. 1. A., Ved.
उपेषते, -षितुम्, to attack.

उपेष् 2. उपेष् (उप-आ-ईष्), cl. 1. A., Ved.
उपेषते, -षितुम्, to approach with a request &c.,
to request.

उपेष् 3. उपेष् (उप-एष्), cl. 1. P. उपेषति,
षितुम्, to creep near, approach.
